MOTOWN WEB: STANDING RULES FOR COPILOT
1. Protected pictures. Never remove, replace, rename, re-crop or edit the logo or any brand or product picture, and never touch apps/web/public/images. Leave exactly as they are: the ImageDefault elements using images.brand.logo.landscape.default and images.theme.vibes in apps/web/src/ui/layout/header/main.tsx, the logo in apps/web/src/ui/common/drawer/nav.tsx, the logos in packages/ui, and the product image block in apps/web/src/ui/common/cards/menu/main.tsx. A step may change only the container size of a picture, and only if it says so.
2. UI-only scope. Do not modify packages/store, packages/db or Prisma files, apps/api, any proxy.ts, route folders or URLs, the provider order in apps/web/src/app/layout.tsx, environment, Docker, Compose or CI files, package.json or lockfiles. Do not add npm dependencies; if one seems needed, stop and ask. Never create env files and never print secret values.
3. No guessing. Read a file before editing it. Quote real code. Write NOT FOUND for anything missing. Never invent field names, routes, prices, opening hours, phone numbers, reviews, ingredients or allergen claims. Content comes from existing data or from a typed config file in apps/web/src/data that renders nothing when it is empty.
4. Reuse first. Use @repo/ui, apps/web/src/ui and Mantine. New web-only components go in apps/web/src/ui/common, partial or layout. Reuse existing hooks, actions and selectors; never rewrite them.
5. Styling. Use Mantine props and the tokens in apps/web/src/app/globals.css. Do not use Tailwind spacing utilities until the Tailwind reset check has been answered. Respect prefers-reduced-motion for every animation.
6. Process. Do only the steps listed in a command. If something is ambiguous, stop and ask instead of choosing. Do not run any git command; the owner runs git. Finish by listing every file you created or changed with a one-line description, then stop. Do not commit or push.
7. Terminal. It is PowerShell. Do not run git, install anything, or start servers. If a command is not found, say so and continue with the file edits. The owner runs lint, type-check and git.
